title: Structural bugfix amendment for visible-ticket-aligned evaluator v4

structural_bugs.evidence: The earlier aggregate-only oracle diagnostic recognized 57/57 expected steps as public METHOD+path signatures, while v4 marked at least one selected aligned expected row as incompletely normalized. The diagnostic and scorer use different path-boundary matchers.
structural_bugs.fix: Replace loose registry-wide path searching with deterministic METHOD+path token extraction, exact path-segment matching to the public registry, and literal-route specificity tie-breaking. Preserve method identity and extract every signature mentioned in one evidence item.

structural_bugs.evidence: The public output schema requires the key trace_quality_self_check.no_locked_test. V4 serialized the whole output including keys and then searched for the substring locked_test, making a valid schema key itself count as leakage.
structural_bugs.fix: Search only string values recursively, never object key names, for locked-test/gold leakage terms.

structural_bugs.evidence: V4 emitted E9_V4_MEASUREMENT_ONLY_PASS whenever at least one call was scoreable, including the observed 4/6 result.
structural_bugs.fix: Emit PASS only when every fixed call is parsed, uniquely ticket-aligned, fully normalized, and scoreable. Otherwise emit NEEDS_REVIEW (or NO_SCOREABLE_CALLS when zero are scoreable).

frozen_semantics.action_and_escalation_supervision_source: deterministic public tool signatures in aligned expected_path.step only
